title: Recover from destructive object events
description: Inject deletion, overwrite, and regional loss, then combine versioning, immutability, replication, and verified inventory. The lab distinguishes prevention, copies, live availability, and tested recovery.

incidents.label: Accidental prefix deletion
incidents.detail: A valid credential removes a large logical dataset and delete markers replicate normally.

incidents.label: Malicious overwrite
incidents.detail: Authorized-looking writes replace current objects with corrupted or encrypted payloads.

incidents.label: Regional serving loss
incidents.detail: The primary object endpoint and colocated application path are unavailable.
